messages.subject: Energy & Resources Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear David,

Energy Search Collective's specialist focus on senior talent across energy and related transition markets makes this a relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans ESG and social performance, government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications, with exposure to renewable-energy, battery-storage and climate-resilience investment alongside mining operations.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where energy and resources strategy, institutional engagement, sustainability performance and responsible growth intersect. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, while I remain internationally mobile for global mandates.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for appropriate current or future searches.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
